deadline.value: Priority deadline is January 15, 2027 for the Fall 2027 start (classes begin August 30, 2027).

app_fee.value: The Botany Program waives the $80 application fee; applicants email botany@cgu.edu to request a waiver code.

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly advised to contact prospective faculty advisors; fit is a key admissions factor because the program is small.
